spans.s: शुभ् (I) vi. 1Ā (pres. शोभते) 1. To look beautiful or handsome, to be beautiful, अधिकं शुशुभे शुभंयुना द्वितयेन द्वयमेव R.viii.6; 2. to appear to advantage, सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते Mrich.i.; 3. to shine.With वि-, to shine.
शुभ् (II) vt. or vi. 6P (pres. शुंभति) 1. To look beautiful; 2. to shine; 3. to hurt, to kill.
शुभ (I) a. (f. भा) 1. Shining, handsome, beautiful, पितुः प्रयत्नात्स समग्रसंपदः शुभैः शरीरावयवैर्दिने दिने R.iii.22; 2. auspicious, lucky, fortunate; 3. distinguished, eminent.
शुभ (II) n. 1. Auspiciousness, good fortune, welfare, M.vii.145; 2. an ornament; 3. a particular fragrant wood.
शुभ (I) a. (f. भा) 1. Shining, handsome, beautiful, पितुः प्रयत्नात्स समग्रसंपदः शुभैः शरीरावयवैर्दिने दिने R.iii.22; 2. auspicious, lucky, fortunate; 3. distinguished, eminent.
शुभा f. 1. Beauty; 2. light, lustre; 3. desire; 4. an assembly of gods; 5. yellow pigment; 6. the śamī tree; 7. the priyangu creeper; 8. a kind of Dūrvā grass.
शुभ-अक्ष m. an epithet of Śiva.
शुभ-अंगी f. 1. an epithet of Rati; 2. a handsome woman.
शुभ-अपांगा f. a beautiful woman.
शुभ-अशुभ n. weal and woe.
शुभ-आनना f. a handsome woman.
शुभ-इतर a. evil, bad.
शुभ-उदर्क a. resulting in happiness.
शुभ-क्षण m.n. a lucky moment.
शुभ-गंधक n. gum-myrrh.
शुभ-ग्रह m. an auspicious planet.
शुभ-द m. the sacred fig tree.
शुभ-दंती f. a woman with good teeth.
शुभंभावुक a. ornamented, decorated.
शुभंयु a. prosperous, fortunate, auspicious, अधिकं शुशुभे शुभंयुना द्वितयेन द्वयमेव संगतम् R.viii.6.
शुभ-लग्न m.n. a lucky moment.
शुभ-वार्ता f. good news.
शुभ-वासन m. perfume for the mouth.
शुभ-शंसिन् a. presaging good.
शुभ-स्थली f. a hall in which sacrifices are performed.
शुभ्र (I) a. (f. भ्रा) 1. Bright, radiant; 2. white, शोभां शुभ्रत्रिनयनवृषोत्खातपंकोपमेयाम् Megh.i.52, R.ii.69.
शुभ्र (II) m. The white colour.
शुभ्र (III) n. 1. Sandal; 2. silver; 3. talc; 4. rock-salt; 5. green vitriol.
शुभ्र (I) a. (f. भ्रा) 1. Bright, radiant; 2. white, शोभां शुभ्रत्रिनयनवृषोत्खातपंकोपमेयाम् Megh.i.52, R.ii.69.
शुभ्रा f. 1. The Ganges; 2. bamboo-manna; 3. crystal.
शुभ्र-अंशु, -कर m. 1. the moon; 2. camphire.
शुभ्र-अंशु, -कर m. 1. the moon; 2. camphire.
शुभ्र-रश्मि m. the moon.
शुभ्रि m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).

सुभग (I) a. (f. गा) 1. Very fortunate, prosperous, happy; 2. beautiful, lovely, charming, pretty, न तु ग्रीष्मस्यैवं सुभगमपराद्धं युवतिषु Sak.iii., R.xi.80; 3. beloved, liked, amiable, सौभाग्यं ते सुभग विरहावस्थया व्यंजयंती Megh.i.29; 4. illustrious.
सुभग (II) m. 1. Borax; 2. the aśoka tree; 3. the champaka tree; 4. red amaranth.
सुभग (III) n. Good fortune.

सुभग (I) a. (f. गा) 1. Very fortunate, prosperous, happy; 2. beautiful, lovely, charming, pretty, न तु ग्रीष्मस्यैवं सुभगमपराद्धं युवतिषु Sak.iii., R.xi.80; 3. beloved, liked, amiable, सौभाग्यं ते सुभग विरहावस्थया व्यंजयंती Megh.i.29; 4. illustrious.
सुभगा f. 1. A woman beloved by her husband, a favourite wife; 2. a kind of wild jasmine; 3. turmeric; 4. the holy basil.
सुभगंमन्य a. considering oneself amiable or liked, वाचालं मां न खलु सुभगंमन्यभावः करोति Megh.ii.31.
सुभंग m. The cocoanut tree.
सुभाषित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Spoken well or eloquently; 2. discoursing well, eloquent.
सुभाषित (II) n. A witty saying, an apopthegm, e.g. पृथिव्यां त्रीणि रत्नानि जलमन्नं सुभाषितम्.
सुभाषित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Spoken well or eloquently; 2. discoursing well, eloquent.
सुभिक्ष n. 1. Good alms, successful, begging; 2. abundance of food, an abundant supply of provisions, plenty.
सुभ्रू (I) a. Lovely-browed, having beautiful eyebrows.
सुभ्रू (II) f. A woman. (The voc. of this word is सुभ्रूः but सुभ्रु often occurs in classics. See K.S.v.43 and Mall. on it, Bt.vi.11, M.M.iii.).
